description: This PHP source file handles the viewing and creation of requirement specifications in the TestLink project. It includes functions for initializing request parameters, rendering a GUI, and checking user rights, and it interacts with various configuration and template components.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves parameters from request and session for handling requirement specification operations.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Renders the graphical user interface for managing requirement specifications, including handling different actions and web editor states.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI bean object with default values and access rights based on the current user and request.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the required permissions to access or modify requirement specifications.
